notes: Introduction of Yoga Asanas. Learnt the Asanas at Adiyogi Alayam.

Very informative and useful week at Adiyogi Alayam. 
No Mobile phones.
GP on 29th July. First Volunteering Experience. Wonderful to volunteer for Guru Purnima. Shorter nights and early morning Shifts at SuryaKund.
Official start of long term Karma Sadhana at IT-ERP-Odoo.
Partner will observe and correct my Yoga Asanas, guided by a Teacher. Very useful indeed.

Wonderful and Joyous experience from the Program. The design, Content, timings, various events, food, ambience of the Program created Suresh 2.0. Thanks to Sadhguru and the Program moderators (Vinod and Shibu Annas) and Volunteers.
Received yellow colour consecrated Sutra from Swamijis'. Tied to all the SP Participants to enhance receptivity. It was presented with utmost reverence.
Thoughtfully designed by Sadhguru and well received the Journal note book in a profound way.
At Kondrai and at Biksha Hall.
Met the IT Lead, Krishnan D Anna. He announced IT Hackathon Event

Key messages - Vak Shuddhi, Every cell Smiles (even your thumb) and transacts continuously. Do not get addicted to anything (takes you no where) but try to venture something more than what you do normally to make it exciting. This is adventure.

Many 00's of SP Participants (Male & Female), Samskrithi Students attended, and Sadhguru's video explaining the Samyama was played at 12:00 noon. This was followed by a 1-2-1 interview for me (like others)  at 3:30 pm. Results in 2 weeks.

While BSP is more for Mind and less for Body, this program is more for Body and less for mind (so to say). This program offered two tools, vis-a-vis Shakthi Chalana Kriya and Shoonya Meditation. All the preparations helped me go through the program with less physical effort. Still i ended up tired. SCK was completely on Vajrasana. In one of the day with outdoor activities i participated on a game and got injured on my left shoulder and ribcage. This program is another level of transformation all towards higher level. Thanks to Sadhguru, Radhika Akka (SCK Teacher) and the entire Volunteer team for this grand program.
